2123209966383169698.en_summary: Great comment: The credit market got to your central banker idea first. Nvidia is rated AA, but its five-year CDS trades around 101–127 basis points, which is where BBB companies sit. That's what happens when you back your customers' debts: your own credit starts trading on theirs. A chipmaker gets priced on its margins, a lender on its worst borrower. Rhymes with my often repeated: "The landlord is only as successful as its tenants." $NVDA
2123209966383169698.zh_summary: 精彩評論：信用市場比你的央行行長想法更早到位。英偉達評級為AA，但其五年期CDS交易在101至127個基點左右，這是BBB公司所在的水平。這就是當你為客戶債務背書時發生的事：你自己的信用開始隨他們交易。芯片製造商按利潤率定價，貸款人按最差借款人定價。呼應我常說的：「房東的成功取決於租戶。」NVDA
